rationale: The core classifier step matches the reference closely: lasso glmnet with 10-fold stratified outer CV repeated three times with recorded seeds, 5-fold inner CV for lambda, TMM/log-CPM/filter/standardization all fitted on the training fold, pooled held-out ROC with DeLong CI plus sensitivity/specificity, selection frequency across folds, and a full-data refit explicitly labeled in-sample; caveats cover the within-cohort limit and the absence of external validation, though balanced accuracy/Brier and a depth-confound check are not named. QC has PCA, distances, library sizes by condition and an explicit outlier keep/exclude rule but no stated policy for a shallow sample. The optional DE arm uses filterByExpr with group, TMM inside voom, explicit control reference and case-vs-control contrast, BH at 0.05 with a p-value histogram; limma reports CIs rather than shrunken fold changes, and the 1.5-fold count is a post hoc tally rather than a treat test. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report specification is thorough with versions, seeds, thresholds and counts.
